column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: one subtest per dialect, so mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set (skipped: /mssql, /mysql; passed: /postgres), not derived from a delta and not counted with all three DSNs set, where it would read zero. Guards cleat#1487's first half: admin.workers makes a worker visible before it holds any work, which the per-workflow assigned_to heartbeat cannot do. Back-dates a heartbeat with the DATABASE clock rather than sleeping, so nothing here asserts on wall-clock time.
